subject: Collaborative MAP: Owners, Velocity, and Contingency Paths
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Collaborative MAP: Owners, Velocity, and Contingency Paths

Hi Eliza — following up from Friday’s demo. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns the 0–90d activation cadence with named owners and acceptance criteria. High-level asks: 1) confirm the three go/no-go checkpoints (Dev Sandbox, Pilot UAT, Production Cutover), 2) validate the Acme internal owner for data onboarding, and 3) flag any procurement timing constraints.

Quick summary of key milestones (see attachment MAP-v1.xlsx):
- Week 0–2: Provisioning + API keys — Redwood: Ben Carter; Acme: David Hsu (data lead)
- Week 3–5: Data ingestion + schema validation — Redwood: Naomi Feldman (integration); Acme: Eliza Turner
- Week 6–8: Pilot UAT + quality checks — Redwood: Marissa Cole (CS); Acme: Product team
- Week 9–12: Production cutover & SLA handoff — Executive sign-off and billing kickoff

Contingency paths I recommend if ingestion slips >5 business days: 1) run a compressed shadow ingestion (minimal schema) to unblock Pilot UAT, or 2) extend the Pilot window and add a scoped regression test. Both options are listed in the MAP with decision owners.

Please review and tell me by EOD Mon if the owners/contacts are correct so we can lock the sprint calendar. If procurement needs a revised SOW, I’ve put a draft in SOW-Acme-draft.pdf and included a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-Acme-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP: Owners, Velocity, and Contingency Paths

Soojin — thanks for the clear plan and the attachment. A few quick notes from Acme:
- Confirmed owners: Data onboarding lead will be David Hsu (cc’d in my internal thread; he’s out today but I’ll loop him in tomorrow).
- Procurement window: we have a vendor review on Jul 28; if the SOW is finalized next week we should be fine, otherwise procurement might push the billing start by ~2 weeks.
- Pilot UAT: Product wants 4 business days (instead of 2) for the first pass. Can you confirm Redwood can extend the UAT window without additional cost?

If you can incorporate the longer UAT and mark the SOW with the revised billing start contingency language, we’re good to proceed. Happy to jump on a 30m call Tues to finalize owners.

Best,
Eliza Turner
Director, Product
Acme Corporation

(Attachment: none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@acme.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP: Owners, Velocity, and Contingency Paths

Thanks Eliza — noted. Ben and I reviewed the MAP and can absorb the extended Pilot UAT (4 business days) within the standard onboarding scope. We’ll update the MAP timeline and the acceptance criteria spreadsheet to reflect the longer UAT and add a labeled contingency bucket for procurement delays.

Action items I’ll own this week:
- Update MAP-v1.xlsx: move UAT window to Week 6–9 and add acceptance checklist (due Tue EOD).
- Update SOW draft to include "billing start subject to successful procurement sign-off; estimated start plus up to 14 days" (Ben to review pricing language).
- Schedule 30m sync with Acme on Tue 11:00am PT — Soojin, can you confirm if that works for Eliza?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: none)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Collaborative MAP: Owners, Velocity, and Contingency Paths

Confirmed — Tue 11:00am PT works for Eliza (I pinged David to join as the data owner). I updated the shared sheet (link below) with the revised UAT window and contingency language; Marissa, thanks for taking the checklist.

Shared links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3cMAP-sprint-owners
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/ACME-SOW-1384

Next steps (owners):
- Marissa: upload updated MAP and acceptance checklist by Tue EOD.
- Ben: finalize SOW pricing clause and send to procurement for redline by Wed.
- Soojin: run the Tue 11am sync and capture any new action items into the MAP.

If procurement indicates the vendor-review gating date cannot be met, we’ll switch to the compressed shadow ingestion contingency (Ben will own technical scope).

Thanks,
Soojin
